info.bio:
Catherine Wheel era una banda de rock alternativo de Great Yarmouth, Inglaterra, La banda era activa desde 1990 hasta el 2000, experimentando niveles que fluctuaban de éxito comercial y emprendiendo viajes muy largos.

Se formó en 1990, abarcando el cantante/guitarrista Rob Dickinson (primo de Bruce), el guitarrista Brian Futter, el bajista Dave Hawes, y al batería Neil Sims.

scenes.name: Psicodelia británica de los noventa
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: La edad de oro de la psicodelia británica no fueron los sesenta sino los noventa: las raves crean una demanda inagotable de música inducida por (o para) las drogas. La versión pop (Telescopes, Inspiral Carpets, Verve, Sundial, Auteurs, Kula Shaker), las más sofisticadas (Curve, Cranberries, Rollerskate Skinny, Beta Band, dEUS, Gorky's Zygotic Mynci), el space-rock libre (Porcupine Tree, Terminal Cheesecake, Heads), los últimos shoegazers (Ride, Swervedriver, Spectrum y E.A.R. de Sonic Boom, Spiritualized de Jason Pierce, Flying Saucer Attack, encuentro de shoegazing y ambient) y el dream-pop (Lush, Pale Saints, Slowdive, Catherine Wheel, Bark Psychosis).

podcast.title: Shoegaze Band Example
podcast.body: The Catherine Wheel was mentioned as an example of a Shoegaze band, a genre that, if not for Grunge's emergence, might have survived more prominently but instead retreated into the background. "There were bands like Slow Dive, Chapter House, Curve, Lush, My Bloody Valentine, Adorable, The Catherine Wheel."

xref.body: Slowdive was mentioned as an example of a Shoegaze band, a loud, fuzzy, buzzy form of guitar rock that emerged from the Thames River Valley in the very late 80s and early 90s. "There were bands like Slow Dive, Chapter House, Curve, Lush, My Bloody Valentine, Adorable, The Catherine Wheel."

xref.title: Shoegaze Band Example
xref.body: Chapter House was mentioned as an example of a Shoegaze band, a genre characterized by lots of distortion, feedback, buried vocals, and a disarming amount of melody, often described as immersive, semi-psychedelic, and dreamy. "There were bands like Slow Dive, Chapter House, Curve, Lush, My Bloody Valentine, Adorable, The Catherine Wheel."
